source_files_consulted: classical source: P.R. Sarkar, Acoustic Roots of the Indo-Aryan Alphabet (uploaded PDF, read-only)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Ka is the acoustic root of the abhīpsātmaka āśā vrtti (hope).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: release of attachment to a specific outcome
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: lets go of the desired result while continuing the effort toward it
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not object-renunciation (Gha), not craving-cessation (Dha), not de-fascination (Na)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of cintā vrtti (worry / impersonal, objective thought).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: composure inside unresolved, impersonal uncertainty
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: holds an unsettled, impersonal situation open without forcing premature resolution
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not self-efficacy (Ya), not threat-steadiness (Pha), not firmness-under-strain (Cha)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Viśvāsa collision: Kha (composure under uncertainty) vs Ya (self-efficacy).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of ceṣṭā vrtti (effort to arouse dormant potential).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: poised rest that halts striving without going inert
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: ceases exertion into a stable, alert repose
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not dull inertia (Ta), not outcome-release (Ka), not containment (Ma)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of mamatā (love/attachment bound by time, space, individuality).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: caring without possessing
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: keeps the loved object on an open hand: loves it while relinquishing ownership
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not outcome-release (Ka), not thirst-cessation (Dha), not indifference (Ba)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: detachment/release family: Ka outcome / Gha ownership / Dha thirst / Na enchantment.

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of dambha vrtti (vanity).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: dropping the performance of oneself for others' eyes
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: removes the outward self-display, letting conduct stand unperformed
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not deflation of the inner I (Ja), not inner/outer honesty (Ña)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Vinaya collision: Ṅa (drop outward display) vs Ja (deflate inner I-claim).

source_attested_pole.english_rendering: Discrimination (real vs unreal, right vs wrong)
source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Ca is the acoustic root of viveka (conscience/discrimination) — the POSITIVE pole is source-attested.

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: undifferentiated conflation
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: conflates real and unreal, right and wrong, blurring necessary distinctions
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not Na's compulsive fascination (Moha), not general confusion, not dullness (Ta)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Viveka collision: Ca is the PROTECTED classical side; Na is the rewritten side.

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of vikalatā vrtti (nervous breakdown).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: steadiness that keeps function intact under strain
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: holds the mind operational under a load that would otherwise break it
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not threat-steadiness (Pha), not forbearance (Da), not poised rest (Ga)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of ahaṁkāra vrtti (ego / inflated I-feeling).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: deflating the inflated I-claim over events
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: withdraws the 'I did / I control this' from one's account of events
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not outward display-dropping (Ṅa), not inner/outer honesty (Ña)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Vinaya collision: Ja (deflate inner I-claim) vs Ṅa (drop outward display).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of lolupatā, lobha (greed) and lolatā (avarice).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: sufficiency: releasing the hoarding grip at enough
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: stops accumulation at sufficiency and releases the surplus grip
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not thirst-cessation (Dha), not non-possessive love (Gha), not outcome-release (Ka)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of kapaṭatā vrtti (hypocrisy).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: transparent alignment of inner intent and outer act
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: makes inner intent and outer act coincide, removing concealment
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not display-dropping (Ṅa), not I-claim deflation (Ja)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of vitarka vrtti (overstating one's case).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: measured speech saying only what is warranted
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: trims expression to exactly the warranted amount
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not honesty of intent (Ña), not indulgence-restraint (Ma), not poised rest (Ga)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of anutāpa vrtti (repentance).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: self-directed release of remorse into self-acceptance
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: discharges remorse over one's own past act into acceptance
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not other-directed forbearance (Da), not shame-release (Ḍa)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Kṣamā collision: Ṭha (self-directed remorse-release) vs Da (other-directed forbearance).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of lajjā vrtti (shyness).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: acting unhindered by social shame
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: releases the inhibiting grip of others' regard on one's action
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not threat-steadiness (Pha), not remorse-release (Ṭha)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: fearlessness collision: Ḍa (release from social shame) vs Pha (steadiness before real threat).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of piśunatā (senseless / sadistic cruelty).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: compassion that answers malice with protection
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: turns malice-energy toward shielding the maligned
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not protection of the physically weak (La), not goodwill against revulsion (Pa)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Karuṇā collision: Ḍha (shield the maligned; social harm) vs La (protect the physically weak).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of īrṣyā vrtti (envy).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: gladness at another's good fortune
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: converts the sting at another's fortune into shared gladness
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not goodwill against revulsion (Pa), not compassion for suffering (Ḍha/La)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of staticity, long sleep and deep sleep.

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: rousing from torpor into active alertness
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: lifts dullness and sleep into active alertness
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not breaking an induced spell (Bha), not poised rest (Ga), not discrimination (Ca)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Jāgaraṇa collision: Ta (lift dullness/sleep) vs Bha (snap an induced spell).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of viṣāda vrtti (melancholy).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: warm uplift that lifts one's own dejection
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: raises one's own dejection into affectionate buoyancy
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not gladness at others' good (Ṇa), not goodwill toward others (Pa)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of peevishness (krodha / karkaśatā).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: other-directed forbearance absorbing provocation
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: absorbs present provocation from another without discharging it back
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not self-remorse-release (Ṭha), not shame-release (Ḍa), not poised rest (Ga)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Kṣamā collision: Da (other-directed forbearance) vs Ṭha (self-directed remorse-release).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of thirst for acquisition (tṛṣṇā).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: extinguishing the acquisitive thirst at its root
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: quenches the thirst-to-acquire itself, not merely a single object
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not outcome-release (Ka), not object non-possession (Gha), not anti-hoarding (Jha)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of moha vrtti (blind attachment / infatuation).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: de-fascination from false attraction
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: breaks the spell of blind attachment by making the attractive object lose compulsive grip
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not Ca/Viveka, not general clarity, not renunciation, not disgust

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Viveka collision: Ca's Viveka PROTECTED; Na rewritten to de-fascination. Distinct from Bha: Na = self-generated infatuation; Bha = externally induced spell.

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of ghṛṇā vrtti (hatred / revulsion).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: goodwill that dissolves revulsion
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: converts revulsion toward another into active goodwill
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not compassion for the suffering (Ḍha/La), not gladness at fortune (Ṇa)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of bhaya vrtti (fear).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: steadiness meeting a genuine threat
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: meets a real danger without collapse or flight
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not social-shame release (Ḍa), not composure under uncertainty (Kha), not firmness-under-strain (Cha)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: fearlessness collision: Pha (steadiness before real threat) vs Ḍa (release from social shame).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of avajñā vrtti (indifference / neglect of the valuable).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: regard that recognizes and attends to worth
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: attends to and honors what has real value instead of neglecting it
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not goodwill against revulsion (Pa), not gladness at fortune (Ṇa)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of mūrcchā vrtti (loss of common sense under a ripu's hypnotic spell).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: breaking the entrancing spell into clear sense
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: snaps an externally-induced hypnotic fixation and restores clear common sense
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not lifting dullness/sleep (Ta), not self-generated de-fascination (Na), not discrimination (Ca)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Jāgaraṇa collision: Bha (snap an induced spell) vs Ta (lift dullness/sleep). Distinct from Na: Bha = externally induced; Na = self-generated infatuation.

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of praṇāśa (annihilation) and praśraya vrtti (giving latitude / indulgence).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: disciplined containment that holds form
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: contains and holds a form against over-indulgence and dissolution
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not measured speech (Ṭa), not forbearance (Da), not poised rest (Ga)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: acoustic root of aviśvāsa vrtti (lack of confidence in oneself and others).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: self-efficacy: the confidence to commit and to rely
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: musters the self-trust needed to commit to an action
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not composure under impersonal uncertainty (Kha), not threat-steadiness (Pha)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Viśvāsa collision: Ya (self-efficacy) vs Kha (composure under uncertainty).

source_attested_pole.english_rendering: vitality / creative fire (dual-attested with sarvanāśa, defeatist annihilation-thought)
source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Ra is the acoustic root of agnitattva/prāṇaśakti (vitality) AND of sarvanāśa (annihilation-thought) — BOTH poles are classically attested.
Sarkar: acoustic root of krūratā vrtti (cruelty), countered by compassion.

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: compassion that protects the physically vulnerable
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: turns harming-energy toward protecting the physically weak
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not shielding the maligned from slander (Ḍha), not goodwill against revulsion (Pa)

entries.collision_resolution_notes: Karuṇā collision: La (protect the physically weak) vs Ḍha (shield the maligned; social harm).

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Va is the acoustic root of dharma — the POSITIVE pole is source-attested.

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: drift from one's sustaining stance
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: loses ensconcement in one's essential order/stance
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not containment of form (Ma), not poised rest (Ga)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Śa is the acoustic root of rajoguṇa (mutative principle) and artha (psychic longing) — a NEUTRAL dynamic principle, not a virtue/vice pole.
Sarkar: acoustic root of tamoguṇa (static principle) and kāma (worldly / physical desire).

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: transmutation of raw desire into grounded drive
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: channels raw sensory desire into a grounded, contained drive
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not thirst-cessation (Dha), not anti-hoarding sufficiency (Jha), not non-possession (Gha)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Sa is the acoustic root of mokṣa (unqualified liberation) and sattvaguṇa — the POSITIVE pole is source-attested.

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: premature withdrawal mimicking release without integration
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: withdraws prematurely, imitating liberation without integrating it
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not outcome-release (Ka), not craving-cessation (Dha), not de-fascination (Na)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Ha is the acoustic root of parā-vidyā (intuitional science) — the POSITIVE pole is source-attested.

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: occluding unknowing
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: veils direct knowing, leaving intuitive insight obscured
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not mundane inferential knowledge (Kṣa), not discrimination (Ca)

source_attested_pole.source_note: Sarkar: Kṣa is the acoustic root of mundane knowledge / material science — the POSITIVE pole is source-attested.

experimental_counter_pole.english_rendering: false certainty held against evidence
experimental_counter_pole.functional_operation: asserts material knowledge falsely, resisting correction by evidence
experimental_counter_pole.contrast_boundary: not intuitional knowledge (Ha), not discrimination (Ca)
